subject: Embeddings API latency spike after model catalog rollout — Astral Health escalation
messages:
From: Claire Marshall <claire@astralhealth.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: data-team@astralhealth.com
Date: 2026-10-02T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Sudden p99 jump on embeddings calls after tonight's catalog change

Vanessa —

We started seeing p95/p99 latency jump on the embeddings endpoint around 07:45 PDT this morning. Throughput and error rates are OK, but 99th percentile has gone from ~120ms to ~1.2s which is causing timeouts in our batch scoring pipeline. This aligns with the model catalog update you rolled last night (your note mentioned new quantized variants).

Attached is a short CSV with request timestamps and observed latencies. Can someone confirm if a model variant was promoted or if there were infra changes in the hosted tier? This is customer-impacting for our production rollout today.

Thanks,
Claire Marshall
Sr. Data Engineer | Astral Health

[attachment: timeline.csv]
From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
To: Claire Marshall <claire@astralhealth.com>
Cc: martha_support@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-02T08:35:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sudden p99 jump on embeddings calls after tonight's catalog change

Claire —

Thank you for the heads up and the CSV. I've triaged this and looped in Marcus (on-call infra) and Hannah (product/ops) to investigate immediately. We're treating this as a priority incident. Initial ask for us: can you confirm whether these are single-call embeddings or batched scoring jobs, and whether the dataset size changed overnight?

I'll send updates every 30 minutes until we stabilize. Apologies for the disruption — we'll get you back to SLOs.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: marcus_lin@redwood.com
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-02T08:42:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Sudden p99 jump on embeddings calls after tonight's catalog change

Forwarding Claire's notes. Quick status from infra: we rolled model-catalog v2026.10.01@23:12 UTC which introduced a new 4-bit quantized variant (embedding-compact-v2-q4). Initial canaries looked fine but we saw higher tail latency under certain sequence-length distributions during canary traffic 45m in.

I've attached a flame-profile and kernel selection trace from one of the affected worker hosts — pointer to the stacktrace in attachments. Hypothesis: the new kernel path for q4 is triggering a less-optimal attention kernel for short sequences common in Astral's workload, producing GC-like stalls when the KV cache path misaligns.

Immediate actions I'm proposing:
- Roll catalog to previous curated variant for Astral's tenant (hot rollback)
- Add synthetic canaries that mirror short-seq batched scoring
- Patch runtime to force alternative kernel selection for q4 for short sequences

Will proceed with rollback in 15 min unless we see a blocker.

-Marcus
Principal SRE | Redwood Inference

[attachment: profile-stacktrace.txt]
From: Claire Marshall <claire@astralhealth.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, martha_support@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-02T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sudden p99 jump on embeddings calls after tonight's catalog change

Vanessa/Marcus —

These are batched scoring jobs (up to 64 inputs per request) initiated from our nightly ETL; sequence lengths are typically <= 96 tokens. We didn't change payload shape. Please proceed with rollback if that helps. We'll hold our rollout until you confirm stability.

Claire
From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
To: marcus_lin@redwood.com, hannah_schmitt@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Cc: Claire Marshall <claire@astralhealth.com>
Date: 2026-10-02T09:35:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Embeddings API latency spike after model catalog rollout — Astral Health escalation

Team —

Thanks for the quick analysis. Marcus: please proceed with the rollback for Astral's production routes and confirm when traffic is routed back to the previous model variant. Hannah: can you draft a short customer note for Claire explaining what happened and the mitigation (rollback plus a plan to harden the rollout/testing)? Include next steps and ETA for a permanent fix.

I'll escalate to leadership if we see the regression persist after rollback. Claire, we'll target an update within 30 minutes and a postmortem within 48 hours.

Best,
Vanessa
From: marcus_lin@redwood.com
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, hannah_schmitt@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Cc: Claire Marshall <claire@astralhealth.com>
Date: 2026-10-02T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Embeddings API latency spike after model catalog rollout — Astral Health escalation

Update: Rolled back tenant routing for Astral Health to embedding-compact-v1 at 09:48 PDT. p99 for Claire's sampled requests dropped from ~1.2s to ~135ms within two minutes. See attached screenshot of latency dashboard. We've pinned Astral's routing to v1 and suspended further q4 promotions for the hosted tier until we ship a kernel selection fix and extended canary coverage.

Next: I'll open INF-4782 for the runtime fix (forcing a different kernel path for short sequences on q4) and INF-4783 to add short-seq synthetic canaries to the catalog pipeline. Hannah, Vanessa — please use those ticket IDs in customer comms and the exec brief.

-Marcus
